t: Forge Steel 5-piece wood chisel set provides essential tools for precise woodworking tasks and timber preparation. Each chisel features a heat-treated chrome vanadium steel blade, ensuring lasting sharpness and durability for professional use on construction sites or in workshops. The fully-forged steel core and steel strike cap offer robustness for effective striking, while bi-material soft-grip handles provide enhanced comfort and control during prolonged operation. The comprehensive set includes an oil stone and honing guide, and is ideal for tradespeople handling intricate carpentry and general timber work.
